summary.context: Repository-wide security, CLI, web, relay, distribution, and product-surface audit at main@9b98467

findings.title: Attacker-authored Gift Wrap becomes victim secret state
findings.issue: Decryption authenticates the sender but selection never requires sender == authenticated owner. Future-dated attacker state wins and is injected into commands.
findings.suggestion: Require expected owner in both unwrap paths, reject mismatched authors/future timestamps, validate environment names, and add malicious-sender CLI/web E2E tests.

findings.title: Master Redshift credential inherited by child processes
findings.issue: REDSHIFT_NSEC/REDSHIFT_BUNKER are copied from process.env into every launched application.
findings.suggestion: Scrub authentication-only variables before injecting requested project secrets.

findings.title: Installer and updater fail open without artifact verification
findings.issue: Current releases provide no checksum/signature/attestation and clients continue when verification data is absent.
findings.suggestion: Generate signed checksums and attestations; fail closed; verify before atomic replacement.

findings.title: Managed relay executes mutable third-party authentication script
findings.issue: nostr-login@latest executes with sign_event permission in the relay origin.
findings.suggestion: Vendor or pin an immutable reviewed build and enforce CSP/SRI.

findings.title: Compiled redshift serve dashboard is blank
findings.issue: The CSP blocks the inline SvelteKit bootstrap. Repeated browser tests found zero interactive elements, while the same build worked in Vite preview.
findings.suggestion: Use a nonce/hash-aware bootstrap policy and add compiled-binary browser E2E.

findings.title: run corrupts argv and breaks --command
findings.issue: Already-tokenized argv is joined and parsed again; spaced arguments split and sh -c argument boundaries are destroyed.
findings.suggestion: Preserve positional argv verbatim; handle --command as an explicit shell mode without re-tokenization.

findings.title: setup overwrite and no-interactive semantics are reversed
findings.issue: Ordinary setup forces overwrite; --no-interactive disables overwrite but does not disable prompts.
findings.suggestion: Separate force and interactive flags; reject missing values in noninteractive mode.

findings.title: Paid managed relay cannot accept normal Redshift Gift Wrap writes
findings.issue: The relay requires the ephemeral outer event author to be authenticated and paid, but Redshift discards that ephemeral key.
findings.suggestion: For kind 1059, authorize/payment-check the authenticated recipient against the p tag while still verifying the outer event.

findings.title: Configuration reads disclose fallback credentials
findings.issue: configure get/--all serialize nsec and bunker client keys.
findings.suggestion: Redact sensitive values by default and require an explicit, warned reveal path.

findings.title: Paid relay read access bypass
findings.issue: Any authenticated key may issue unrestricted REQ filters without a payment check.
findings.suggestion: Enforce paid/allowed identity before subscriptions and define recipient-scoped read policy.

findings.title: Relay rate limit bypass through parallel connections
findings.issue: Fresh per-session buckets multiply limits for the same pubkey.
findings.suggestion: Use shared per-authenticated-pubkey quotas plus a connection-level limiter.

findings.title: Bunker pairing secret leaks through process arguments/errors
findings.issue: Secret-bearing bunker URIs are visible to process observers/logs and can be echoed in errors.
findings.suggestion: Accept via hidden stdin/environment and redact the supplied URI/query in errors.

findings.title: Local bunker lacks inbound request bounds
findings.issue: Arbitrary senders can trigger verification, decryption, encryption, signing, and publication work without age/size/rate limits.
findings.suggestion: Add global/per-client token buckets and event age/content size limits before expensive work.

findings.title: Project/environment deletion leaves secret bundles active or historically recoverable
findings.issue: Deletion does not tombstone every d-tag, and user-signed NIP-09 cannot delete ephemeral-authored Gift Wraps.
findings.suggestion: Tombstone affected d-tags, correct documentation, and design key rotation/retention rather than claiming NIP-09 erasure.
